result.title: From Structural Feedback to Prompt Policies: Learning Faithful Text-to-Image Prompt Editors
result.summary: Prompt optimization should improve the image a user receives without changing the scene the user requested. Yet stylistic rewriting can weaken object attributes and relations even when global text--image similarity remains high. We propose StruPO, a structure-aware prompt editor that uses a calibrated scene graph as a shared representation for policy conditioning and image-grounded supervision. The graph exposes what should be preserved, while deletion, reordering, and insertion provide a token-aligned way to modify the prompt. This turns structural feedback from an external critique into a training signal for a reusable editing policy. Learning from that signal requires handling both uncertain grounding and stochastic image generation. StruPO retains grounding confidence through smooth reward shaping and averages multiple images for each edit before computing group-relative advantages. Experiments span three disjoint 2K-prompt test sets and four frozen generation backbones, with comparisons to learned prompt optimizers, iterative structural feedback, diffusion-model fine-tuning, and inference-time attention control. StruPO improves the faithfulness--aesthetics trade-off, with consistent gains in relational fidelity. Independent automatic evaluators and a 15-annotator study provide complementary evidence, and human preference margins increase with relation complexity. Controlled ablations connect these gains to graph conditioning, local editing, and image-grounded learning. The resulting policy produces reusable optimized text in one pass after graph calibration, without an iterative critique--rewrite loop.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 StruPO，一种结构感知的 text-to-image 提示编辑器：以校准后的场景图作为策略条件与图像监督的共享表示，通过删除、重排、插入的 token 级编辑，并用平滑奖励和多图平均的组相对优势训练可复用的一遍式编辑策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将外部结构批评转成训练信号、以场景图条件取代迭代 critique–rewrite 循环的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉结构保留、证据筛选与是否继续迭代的决策提供核查线索；但任务属图像生成，与 VLM 推理联系间接。
